notes.title: UPDATE - Various fixes & new feature!
notes.content:
A new update has been released with various optimisations that aim to address all the issues reported by players being stuck on the phone at the beginning of the game!

Alongside those, the following have been added:

- Added a HOME Button on the UI
- Added a feature to Skip Dialogue (Availability indicated on UI)

notes.title: UPDATE - Various fixes & new feature!
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thank you for your continuous feedback and support for [b]Remember When[/b]!

A new update has been released with [b]various optimisations[/b] that aim to address all the issues reported by players being stuck on the phone at the beginning of the game!

Alongside those, the following have been added:

[b]- Added a HOME Button on the UI
- Added a feature to Skip Dialogue (Availability indicated on UI)[/b]

One again, thank you for playing and enjoying Remember When!

You can find, and contact us on [url=https://twitter.com/_ArrowGames]Twitter[/url]

Stay awesome!

Lefkos Savvides
Arrow Games
